title: Aurora Museum & Cultural Centre

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Enroll your camper today for a week of non-stop fun in the Aurora Cultural Centre’s visual arts camps! Campers will spend lively days under the guidance of their enthusiastic artist-counsellors. A typical day will find them in their the art studio, exploring current exhibitions in the Centre’s galleries, along with plenty of outdoors fun and creating in the beautiful Aurora Town Square plaza. Pack your bags with your favorite potions and shield, it’s time to go on an adventure! Inspired by storybooks and fairytales, campers will delve into the world of fantasy, myths and legends and create art pieces inspired by unicorns, dragons, mermaids, monsters, and more sparking boundless imagination!
